cosmosbeta-desc: Cosmos is a skin designed and based off Fandom's Oasis skin. Designed to improve upon their design, and provide an efficient MediaWiki skin for non-Fandom users, or for users transitioning out of Fandom. If you wish, you may join the [https://discord.gg/GPVgFTaQTJ Cosmos Discord server] if you require assistance with theming or something else.
cosmosbeta-themedesigner-advanced-help: The theme as JSON. Anything invalid is ignored when you publish.
cosmosbeta-themedesigner-color-banner-he: Background of the bar with search and the user menu.
cosmosbeta-themedesigner-color-content-h: Background of articles and the rail.
cosmosbeta-themedesigner-color-header-he: Background of the wiki name and navigation tabs.
cosmosbeta-themedesigner-color-invalid: That is not a color the designer understands.
cosmosbeta-themedesigner-color-toolbar-h: Background of the page tools at the bottom.
cosmosbeta-themedesigner-colors-intro: Use the picker or type any CSS color. Leave a field empty to use the default for this wiki.
cosmosbeta-themedesigner-darkmode-auto-h: Automatic shows the light colors, and switches to the dark colors for visitors whose browser or device asks for a dark color scheme. Their own choice with the switch always wins.
cosmosbeta-themedesigner-darkmode-builti: The switch is a button in the wiki header. Logged in users keep their choice in their preferences. Visitors keep it in their browser.
cosmosbeta-themedesigner-darkmode-genera: Make dark colors from the light ones
Dark colors made. Check them under Colors, then publish.
cosmosbeta-themedesigner-darkmode-intro: Cosmos has a dark mode of its own. Each mode keeps its own colors, so you can edit them separately under Colors.
cosmosbeta-themedesigner-darkmode-toggle: Let people switch between light and dark
cosmosbeta-themedesigner-error-json: The theme data could not be read.
cosmosbeta-themedesigner-error-permissio: You do not have permission to change the theme.
cosmosbeta-themedesigner-error-token: Your session expired. Reload the page and try again.
cosmosbeta-themedesigner-footer-hidden-h: These are the footer links that exist on this wiki.
cosmosbeta-themedesigner-footer-icons-lo: The configuration of this wiki does not allow hiding the footer icons.
cosmosbeta-themedesigner-history-intro: Every published theme is kept. Restoring one publishes it again as the newest version.
cosmosbeta-themedesigner-image-upload-co: Uploaded from the Cosmos theme designer
cosmosbeta-themedesigner-image-upload-ex: A file with that name already exists. Rename it and try again.
cosmosbeta-themedesigner-image-upload-fa: The file could not be uploaded.
cosmosbeta-themedesigner-images-intro: Type a file name from this wiki, pick an uploaded file, upload a new image, or use a full web address. Leave empty for none.
cosmosbeta-themedesigner-layout-backdrop: Background blur behind see through areas
Blurs what is behind the banner, content area, footer and page tools when their colors are see through. Browsers that cannot blur get a more opaque background instead.
cosmosbeta-themedesigner-layout-button-s: The look of the edit, cancel and other buttons above the page title.
cosmosbeta-themedesigner-layout-header-b: Draws a thin line below the page title and the page buttons, separating them from the content.
cosmosbeta-themedesigner-nojs: The theme designer needs JavaScript. You can still edit the settings under Advanced.
cosmosbeta-themedesigner-preset-applied: Palette applied. Publish to make it live.
cosmosbeta-themedesigner-presets-intro: Pick a ready made palette. It replaces the colors for its mode, and you can still change each color afterwards.
cosmosbeta-themedesigner-protected: The configuration of this wiki does not allow hiding this link.
cosmosbeta-themedesigner-rail-anons: Hide the rail from visitors who are not logged in
cosmosbeta-themedesigner-rail-custom-exi: A module for that message already exists
cosmosbeta-themedesigner-rail-custom-inv: Use only letters, numbers, dots, dashes and underscores
cosmosbeta-themedesigner-rail-custom-mes: The name of a page in the MediaWiki namespace, without the prefix. Its content becomes the module.
cosmosbeta-themedesigner-rail-intro: Choose when the rail appears, then set up each module in it on its own.
cosmosbeta-themedesigner-rail-module-pla: The lists below replace the rail ones for this module only. Leave both empty to show the module on every page.
cosmosbeta-themedesigner-rail-modules-he: Every module the rail can show on this wiki, including those added by extensions.
cosmosbeta-themedesigner-rail-namespaces: Modules are hidden in these namespaces unless they have page rules of their own. Leave empty for the wiki default.
cosmosbeta-themedesigner-rail-pages-help: Modules are hidden on these pages unless they have page rules of their own. Leave empty for the wiki default.
cosmosbeta-themedesigner-rail-pages-plac: Search pages or type a title
cosmosbeta-themedesigner-readonly: You can look at the current theme, but you do not have permission to change it.
cosmosbeta-themedesigner-text: Customize how the '''Cosmos''' skin looks on this wiki. Changes go live when you publish, and every published version is kept so you can go back to it.
cosmosbeta-themedesigner-toolbar-hidden-: These are the page tools that exist on this wiki.
cosmosbeta-themedesigner-toolbar-style-h: The rail option puts the page tools in the rail as a module. On pages without a rail they show as a full width bar instead.
